title: Stop using my chats to train models
path: Settings > Data controls > Improve the model for everyone
why: Your conversations can be used to train future models unless you turn this off.

title: Turn off memory
why: Memory keeps details from past chats and reuses them in new ones.

title: Turn off Apple Intelligence
path: Settings > Apple Intelligence & Siri > Apple Intelligence
why: Switching it off stops on-device and cloud AI features from processing your content.

title: Turn off Apple Intelligence and Siri
why: Siri and AI features can send requests and content to Apple servers.

title: Stop Siri suggestions and learning from apps
path: Settings > Apple Intelligence & Siri > Apps > choose an app > Learn from this App
why: Siri learns from how you use each app to make suggestions.

title: Stop sharing analytics with Apple
path: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Share iPhone Analytics
why: Usage and diagnostic data is sent to Apple, and to app developers if you allow it.

title: Turn off optional connected experiences
path: Settings > General > Privacy and data > Connected experiences
why: Connected experiences send your content to online services to power suggestions.

title: Turn off optional diagnostic data
path: Settings > Privacy & security > Diagnostics & feedback > Send optional diagnostic data
why: Optional diagnostics can include browsing and app activity details.

title: Stop saving snapshots
path: Settings > Privacy & security > Recall & snapshots > Save snapshots
why: Recall takes periodic screenshots of your screen and stores them on the device.

title: Turn off Copilot page context
path: Settings > Copilot and sidebar > Copilot > Allow Microsoft to access page content
why: Copilot can read the pages you browse to answer questions about them.

title: Turn off Gemini Apps Activity
why: Saved activity can be reviewed by people and used to improve Google products.

title: Turn off ad privacy features
path: Settings > Privacy and security > Ad privacy
why: Chrome can share topics and site data with advertisers for ad personalisation.

title: Pause Web & App Activity
path: myaccount.google.com > Data & privacy > Web & App Activity > Turn off
why: Your searches and app use are saved to your account and used for personalisation.

title: Turn off data collection and use
path: Settings > Privacy & Security > Firefox Data Collection and Use
why: Firefox can send technical and interaction data to Mozilla.

title: Turn off Data for Generative AI Improvement
path: Settings > Data privacy > Data for Generative AI Improvement
why: Your profile and posts can be used to train generative AI models.

title: Stop allowing GitHub to use my data for training
path: Settings > Copilot > Features > Allow GitHub to use my data for product improvements
why: Your prompts and suggestions may be used to improve Copilot.
